description: Multipart upload: a text field with a parameter, a text file, a binary file, and a FilePath= file sent under the Value= filename. Parts are compared by name, filename, Content-Type and bytes; the boundary is the sender's own.
source: VuGen 26.1 Function Reference: web_submit_data (EncType=multipart/form-data; ITEMDATA File=Yes, FilePath, ContentType).
